title: Dashboard compareTo on a forward date preset (下月, 下季度, 未来 30 天) compares the window with itself
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Filing gate: ③ a should-fix from the contract review of PR #30133 (#30076, review 6634808446), carried as a follow-up so the spec PR stays in scope. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2, because a dashboard shows a wrong number and a wrong label once #30133 lands. Route: `domain:ui`.

**What a user sees.** #30133 adds three forward presets: `next_month` (下月), `next_quarter` (下季度) and `next_30_days` (未来 30 天). A dashboard widget that picks one of them and turns on "compare to previous period" shows a change of 0 every time. The trend label also names the wrong comparison, "vs last month".

**Why.** On PR #30133's head, `ui/packages/core/src/utils/compare-to.ts` ≈:55-62 builds `previousPeriod` by substituting `current_*` and `today` tokens with `last_*` and `yesterday`. A forward window is spelled in `next_*` or `{N_days_from_now}` tokens, so nothing is substituted, and the "previous" window is the window itself. The label is taken from the token text (≈:129-132): `month` → `vsLastMonth`. The PR's `dashboard-filters.presetWindows-29116.test.ts` runs its compareTo case over the 13 earlier presets only (`RETIRED_PRESETS`, ≈:135-165), so nothing pins the three new ones.

## Wanted

- [ ] Decide what "previous period" means for a forward window. The natural reading is the equal-length window just before it. For 下月 that is this month, for 下季度 this quarter, and for 未来 30 天 the 31 days ending yesterday. Implement it, and make the trend label name that comparison.
- [ ] Extend the 29116 compareTo case to all 16 presets.

Blocked-by: #30076
